headline: R-Type's volley pre-dodge goes live; the nightly freeze cleared twice over
lede: The fortress-fan fix is on production: both R-TYPE brains now read the inbound salvo lane and step off the aim line. Along the way tonight's red main was diagnosed to the character — and closed as a duplicate when the other lane's identical fix merged first.

notes.text: R-TYPE volley pre-dodge shipped (#2951 → b779123): marked fan rounds, fanSlip for both brains, and a crossing-sign root fix that had left the lane field blind to straight fire since S1. Solo winnable 8/12 (was 7), co-op 12/12. Prod-verified in the served chunk.

Nightly red #2 diagnosed: watchcheck's FloorBoss watch-pin window (200 chars) was outrun by the S2 tap bank at ~206. The honesty law was intact — autopilot pad still feeds the episode tick — and the pin still bites when the pad is faked. Shipped as calibration; duplicate of the sibling lane's #2962, closed with the trail on #601.

Distance windows in source pins rot silently when games grow — both of today's freezes were windows, not laws. And pull_request CI keeps missing lane PRs: gate on the head-SHA static check via the API, dispatch ci.yml when the event doesn't fire.
